title: Comparing diversity, negativity, and stereotypes in Chinese-language AI technologies: an investigation of Baidu, Ernie and Qwen
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion' as one of the 13 specific social categories used to evaluate biases and stereotypes in Chinese-language AI models. It specifically analyzes how models represent groups such as Buddhists and Taoists, and it addresses the ethical implications and responsibilities associated with these biases in AI technologies.
